data.name: PermissionDenied
data.value: You do not have permission to perform this action.

data.name: NotAuthenticated
data.value: You must be signed in to a tenant to perform this action.

data.name: NotFound
data.value: The case was not found or you do not have access to it.

data.name: CaseClosed
data.value: The case is closed, so its checklist can no longer be changed.

data.name: NotLockHolder
data.value: Only the user who holds the case can tick or untick its checklist items.

data.name: ItemNotFound
data.value: The checklist item was not found on this case.

data.name: ItemNotShown
data.value: This item is not currently shown on the case, so it cannot be ticked.

data.name: ItemAlreadyDone
data.value: This item has already been ticked.

data.name: ItemNotDone
data.value: This item has not been ticked, so there is nothing to untick.

data.name: ValidationFailedDefault
data.value: The condition for ticking this item is not met.

data.name: OverrideForbidden
data.value: You do not have permission to override the checklist gate.

data.name: OverrideReasonRequired
data.value: A reason is required to override the checklist gate.

data.name: OverrideReasonTooLong
data.value: The reason must be no more than 1000 characters.

data.name: OverrideHolderCannotOverride
data.value: The user who holds the case cannot override its checklist gate; a supervisor must.

data.name: OverrideNothingOpen
data.value: There are no open checklist items, so there is nothing to override.

data.name: OverrideAlreadyGranted
data.value: An override has already been granted for the status the case is in.
